case_title: PARA SEENAIAH & ANR. v. STATE OF ANDHRA PRADESH & ANR.
statutory_provisions: IPC s.302, s.34; Arms Act s.27
trial_court_outcome: Acquitted of all charges but convicted A-1, A-2 and A-4 under s. 326 IPC
high_court_outcome: Affirmed conviction of A-2 and A-4 under s. 326 IPC, altered conviction of A-1 to s. 324 IPC
offence_finally_established: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder
neutral_facts: The accused and the complainant were part of two factions in a village with a strained relationship. The deceased was attacked by the accused after an incident involving the son of one of the accused. Four witnesses witnessed the initial attack and later returned to the scene to inquire about the deceased's condition. The deceased provided a statement to the Investigating Officer implicating the accused. Medical evidence showed the deceased sustained multiple injuries, including fractures and lacerations. The trial court acquitted the accused of murder but convicted them under Section 326 IPC. The High Court affirmed the conviction of A-2 and A-4 under Section 326 IPC and altered the conviction of A-1 to Section 324 IPC.
